coverage: HDFC Asset Management Company and subsidiaries
change: Fee revenue grew faster than profit. HDFC AMC earns fees for managing investments, and the amount it manages changes as people add or withdraw money and as markets move.
watch: Watch whether people keep putting more into HDFC funds than they take out, and how much fee income the company earns on the money it manages.
